title: Revisiting Congestion Control for Lossless Ethernet
authors: Yiran Zhang; Qingkai Meng; Chaolei Hu; Fengyuan Ren
venue_full: Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beihang University

problem_statement.en: Lossless Ethernet networks suffer from congestion spreading, Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking, and deadlock due to the limitations of Priority-based Flow Control (PFC) and sub-optimal congestion control schemes.
problem_statement.zh: 無損 Ethernet 網路因 Priority-based Flow Control（PFC）的局限性與次優壅塞控制機制，而面臨壅塞擴散、Head-of-Line（HoL）阻塞及死鎖等問題。

key_innovation.en: ACK-driven congestion control (ACC) that leverages the packet conservation property of lossless networks to infer network pipe capacity and excessive packets, using a two-step strategy of temporary source halting followed by rate matching.
key_innovation.zh: ACK 驅動的壅塞控制（ACC）：利用無損網路的封包守恆特性推斷網路管道容量及多餘封包數，採用「暫停發送端」後接「速率匹配」的兩階段策略。

key_improvements.en: 1.3~3.3x improvement in average FCT and 1.4~11.5x improvement in 99th percentile FCT for small flows compared to existing schemes.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於現有方案，小流的平均 FCT 提升 1.3~3.3x，第 99 百分位 FCT 提升 1.4~11.5x。

ai_task: AI applications, Data processing, Storage workloads (NVMe-over-Fabrics)
